result.title: ACSeL: Adaptive Configuration Search for Hardware-Constrained LLM Inference
result.summary: Serving large language models (LLMs) under tight memory and latency service-level objectives (SLOs), including on edge devices, requires jointly selecting the model size, batch size, quantization algorithm, and mixed-precision quantization recipes. Exhaustive search over this combinatorially large space is infeasible. Unlike data-center serving, which often prioritizes throughput or generation speed, resource-constrained deployments typically set memory and latency budgets as constraints and then seek the configuration with the highest generation quality among feasible ones. To this end, we propose ACSeL, a framework that identifies configurations predicted to satisfy deployment constraints while achieving high predicted generation quality. To enable efficient quality estimation, we use Relative Model Quality Degradation (RMQD), a proxy based on the divergence between the candidate and reference models' next-token distributions over a small calibration corpus. Across the evaluated model sizes and precisions, RMQD is inexpensive to evaluate and strongly correlated with downstream benchmark performance. ACSeL combines (i) a lightweight quality surrogate that predicts RMQD directly from a configuration; (ii) Few-shot Median Calibration (FMC), which calibrates operator-profile-based latency estimates using a small number of end-to-end profiles; and (iii) a structured search algorithm BandPareto for exploring layerwise mixed-precision configurations. Experiments on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 workstation and an NVIDIA Jetson Thor edge platform show that FMC substantially improves deployment feasibility, while BandPareto + FMC achieves the highest feasibility and the lowest RMQD gaps to the best measured configurations in the evaluation set.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 ACSeL，在内存与延迟约束下联合搜索模型规模、批大小、量化算法与逐层混合精度配置，并用基于 next-token 分布散度的质量代理 RMQD 结合少样本延迟校准与 BandPareto 搜索来筛选可行配置。
AI.relevance_reason: 属部署系统层面的配置搜索与量化，不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态、证据使用或停止决策，质量代理也仅用于约束下的工程选型，缺少可核查的 LVR 方法线索。
